faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.lead: Can't find what you need? Ask in the message box of the booking request.
faq.q1: Do I need any surfing experience?
faq.a1: No. There are lessons for every level, from people who have never stood on a board to advanced surfers.
faq.a2: Yes — there are kids' lessons and families are welcome. Minimum age:
faq.q3: Are there lessons for people with disabilities or special needs?
faq.a3: Yes. Mundaka Surf Academy offers adaptive lessons. Tell us about your needs in the booking request and the session is planned with you.
faq.a4: The academy publishes a timetable every month from March to September. Pick your preferred date in the booking request; availability is confirmed in the reply.
faq.a5: Use the booking request on this page: choose a lesson, a date and your group, and send it. The academy replies to confirm.
faq.q6: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a6: No. You book as a guest, and only the details needed to answer your request are asked for.
faq.a7: The academy plans to accept card payment online, a deposit online with the rest paid on the day, and payment on arrival. Online payment is not active yet, so sending a request never charges you.
faq.q8: Can I rent a board or wetsuit?

meta.title: Privacy policy — Mundaka Surf Academy
meta.description: How Mundaka Surf Academy uses the personal data you send through this website.

controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
controller.text: The data controller for this website is the owner of Mundaka Surf Academy:

data.title: What data we collect
data.text: Only what you type into the booking request: your name, email address, phone number (optional), the lesson, date and group details you choose, and anything you write in the message box — including, if you decide to share it, information about a disability or special needs so that the lesson can be adapted. This website does not use analytics or advertising tools.

purpose.title: Why we use it
purpose.text: To answer your request, check availability, organise and confirm your lesson and, once online payment is introduced, process your booking through the payment provider.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.text: Your consent when you send the form, and the steps needed before entering into a contract for the lesson you request (Article 6(1)(a) and (b) GDPR). Information about health or disability is processed only with your explicit consent (Article 9(2)(a) GDPR) and only to plan your lesson safely.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: For as long as needed to manage your request and booking, and to meet legal obligations. Retention period:

recipients.title: Who receives it
recipients.text: Your data is never sold or used for advertising. It may be handled by the service that delivers form messages to the academy and, in future, by the payment provider, both acting on the academy's behalf.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to or restrict its use, and receive a copy (portability) by writing to the contact address above. You can also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: This website does not set cookies. It only keeps, in your own browser, the plan and email you type on the plans page while you move to the booking form (session storage, cleared when you close the tab). The map on the location page loads from OpenStreetMap only if you click to load it.
